description: Shrink a PDF from freedailypro as far as it will go (the site's Extreme mode): everything Aggressive does, then every page as 70 dpi greyscale and as pure black-and-white JBIG2 (exact, then with shared letter shapes), keeping the smallest. Colour and shading are lost and text is no longer selectable; very rarely a letter in tiny print can be swapped for a look-alike one in the symbol-mode result, so check important numbers in the original. Heavy: several seconds per page; returns the best level finished so far (truncated: true) if the time budget runs out. Errors if the PDF is unreadable, password-protected, over 100 pages, or if nothing gets smaller.

fileBase64.description: The PDF, base64 encoded (up to 20 MB, up to 100 pages)

name: pdf_compress_extreme
